evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Business-driven security architecture and a recognized framework provide a useful foundational design vocabulary; zero experience, training dependence and multiple-choice exams do not establish applied architect responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Business-driven security-architecture concepts and a recognized framework provide foundational design knowledge. Zero experience and multiple-choice course-linked assessment do not prove professional architecture delivery, regardless of training cost.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded business-driven security-architecture framework is relevant technical and advisory groundwork. Its multiple-choice format and zero experience requirement keep it foundational despite the substantial course cost.
